board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 3D:C8

ctl.what: kixel-ai/rind main 8a5977ad as it is (HACL* Poly1305 in u64 limbs, HACL* ChaCha20; rolled SHA-512 is upstream's default here, #944)

zero.what: + key wipe as one memset on Xtensa

rot.what: + ChaCha20 rotates as ssai/src (rounds4), with the word XOR (#295 head)

notag.what: #296 at d3f3374f with a bench-only local patch that keeps the u64 tag add (branchless block loop only); not on any branch

poly.what: + branchless Poly1305 block loop and 16-bit-halves tag add (#296 at d3f3374f)

method: Interleaved A/B. One flash = one boot = one run. A run's value for a row is the median over that boot's complete rounds (rows before the first '# round complete' dropped) of the firmware's printed median_ns. Each result here is one flash.
